name: WPDS MCP setup and tool discovery
query: I want to build a confirmation modal using the WordPress Design System. How do I set up the WPDS MCP server, and which MCP tools should you call before writing the UI?
expected_behavior: Identify @wordpress/design-system-mcp (requiring Node.js 22.13.0+) as the official WPDS MCP server and note that Automattic/wpds-mcp is archived.
Provide client setup instructions from references/mcp-setup.md (claude mcp add, codex mcp add, or mcp.json using npx -y --ignore-scripts --min-release-age=2 @wordpress/design-system-mcp@latest).
Do not search the web for canonical WPDS documentation; query the MCP server instead.

Call get_patterns (and get_pattern_details if a pattern matches, e.g. destructive-actions) before choosing components, then call get_component_details (and get_components if needed) and get_design_tokens for custom styling.
success_criteria: Notes that Automattic/wpds-mcp is archived and superseded
Uses get_patterns, get_pattern_details, get_components, get_component_details, and get_design_tokens rather than legacy wpds:// URIs alone
Refuses or avoids unapproved web search for canonical WPDS docs
